entities.summary: Lake Vozhe, also known as Lake Charondskoye, is a lake in the northern part of Vologda Oblast in Russia. The area of the lake is 416 square kilometres (161 mi2), and the area of its basin is 6,260 square kilometres (2,420 mi2). The average depth is around 2 metres (6.6 ft). Lake Vozhe drains through the Svid into Lake Lacha, from which the Onega flows out. The lake is located on a flatland and its shores are low-lying and swampy. The biggest swamp, the Charonda Swamp, is located to the southeast of the lake.
